declarations.docstring: The kernel of the selected monoid homomorphism is the designated subgroup.
The selected monoid homomorphism is onto.
A three-entry family of elements in the source group.
A distinguished subgroup of the source group.
The quotient by the distinguished subgroup is multiplicatively equivalent to permutations of three points.
A finite-dimensional complex representation of the source group.
Its character is obtained by evaluating the target representation's character after the quotient map.
The pulled-back representation and the comparison representation have identical characters.
The pulled-back representation is isomorphic to the comparison representation.
The target fixed-point statistic after the quotient map equals the source fixed-point statistic.
The two displayed actions on three points agree pointwise.
The two displayed fixed-point counts agree for every group element.
The selected representation has the same character as the pulled-back representation.
The selected representation is isomorphic to the pulled-back representation.
